firm_data.firm_description: Kirby McInerney LLP, founded over 70 years ago, represents institutional investors, governmental entities, and individuals in matters of securities, antitrust, healthcare, consumer, corporate governance, whistleblower, and ERISA fraud. The firm traces its lineage to the dawn of U.S. securities law and has recovered billions of dollars for its clients.
notable_facts: The firm's founder was in the first generation of securities lawyers and rendered service to the SEC in its earliest years.
Kirby McInerney has offices in New York, NY, California, and Singapore.
The firm often offers its services on a contingency fee basis.

email.subject: AI for Kirby McInerney, built for securities-focused firms
email.body:
Hi Daniel,

Your firm's lineage to the first generation of securities lawyers and early SEC service sets you apart. That institutional investor focus and recovery track record demands precision tools that most legal tech ignores.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
